# navig-video

<!-- navig:plugin-card:start -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_plugin_catalog.py — edit the plugin's pyproject.toml, not this block. -->

> Render a channel's video formats (kinetic episodes, bulletins, motion cards) from its workspace of texts, plates and voice: timeline → frames → ffmpeg, with per-destination encode variants.

**Works on its own** — its own CLI, no navig required · v0.3.0 · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/navig-video/)

**On its own** (no navig needed)

```bash
pip install navig-video
navig-video --help   # no navig needed
```

**With navig**

```bash
pip install "navig[video]"
navig video --help
```

<details><summary>Commands</summary>

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `navig video cut` | 🎬 Render an EDL — the editable timeline — into its outputs. |
| `navig video doctor` | Deep check: workspace layout, engines, ffmpeg, fonts. Exit 1 if a requirement fails. |
| `navig video kinetic plan` | 🗓 The timeline without rendering — beat times, words, plates, cuts. |
| `navig video kinetic render` | 🎬 Render kinetic episodes — voice timing drives every cut. |
| `navig video parity` | ⚖ Do two renders match? Container, pixels, audio — the porting contract. |
| `navig video status` | Workspace, engines and render verbs — one glance at what is wired. |

</details>

<!-- navig:plugin-card:end -->

Render a channel's video formats — kinetic episodes, bulletins, motion cards and
per-destination encode variants — from its workspace of texts, plates and voice:
timeline → frames → ffmpeg. It runs on its own as `navig-video`, and inside navig as
`navig video`.

## On its own

```bash
pip install navig-video                 # adds the `navig-video` command
navig-video status                      # workspace, ffmpeg, engines, verbs
navig-video doctor                      # deep checks — exit 1 names what is missing
pip install "navig-video[render]"       # + navig-audio, navig-media-core, navig-generate, Pillow, numpy
```

The workspace (media, copy, voice, beds) stays where it is — pass `--workspace` or
set `NAVIG_WORKSPACE`. Media never enters this repo: only the rendering code lives
here. ffmpeg is probed on `PATH` (never a pip dependency); keys resolve from the
environment or the shared vault (`navig-vault`).

## Inside navig

The same commands are `navig video …`.

## Why it exists

The channel's render engines (word-timed kinetic, bulletin pages, per-destination
encode) are a video domain of their own — audio owns voice and beats, generate owns
stills and the frame engine, and this plugin owns the timelines that turn them into
video. A render verb ships only at parity with the channel's existing script output
(same frames, duration and loudness); until then the scripts stay the fallback.
